decision: Do not retain another runtime change from this audit. The measured candidates either saved negligible bytes, added requests, or increased the hydrated footprint on a sampled route. All experimental source changes were reverted; earlier workspace work is preserved.

baseline.description: Includes the earlier preview-context and StoryblokEditable controller optimizations, plus the pre-existing page/theme changes.

previewAudit.method: Inspect Next analyzer bootstrap groups for the public catch-all route and the scripts requested by production browser samples.
previewAudit.remaining: Small synchronous context/marker boundaries and the conditional bridge subscription loader remain. SettingsPageProvider also owns public document reconciliation, so its state handling is not exclusively preview code.
previewAudit.publicStoryblokCode: The remaining @storyblok/react rich-text renderer and @storyblok/richtext code render public CMS content; they are not editor-only dependencies.

experiments.name: Replace two next-seo processor calls with equivalent object mappings
experiments.result: Discarded. The emitted processor registry remained in the public module despite removing these call sites; the production saving was negligible.

experiments.name: SSR-enabled dynamic registration for navigation lists
experiments.result: Discarded. Too little compressed saving to justify another initial request.

experiments.name: SSR-enabled dynamic registrations for navigation lists and dividers
experiments.result: Discarded. Added an initial request; the subsequent divider-only browser trace also established an additional cost on pages rendering dividers after hydration.

experiments.name: SSR-enabled dynamic registration for dividers only

browser.explanation: The initial HTML script counts omitted a divider chunk loaded after hydration on /de/de. Full browser request capture revealed that the total cost increased there.

experiments.result: Discarded after browser measurement. UI and compatibility checks passed, but the small savings elsewhere did not justify the additional request and bytes on this route.

largerDependencies.auth0: The analyzer attributed roughly 242 KB minified / 66 KB individually compressed to @auth0/auth0-react. This app explicitly uses Auth0App and Auth0Page; removing or deferring initialization could change session restoration, redirects, locale selection, and authenticated UI. No auth behavior was changed.
largerDependencies.nextSeo: The analyzer attributed about 22 KB minified to next-seo's main module. Its processor registry is a potential packaging/tree-shaking investigation, but the direct call-site experiment did not remove it. No dependency patch or replacement serializer was introduced.
largerDependencies.reactAndMui: Most other large initial modules implement React, routing, theming, and visible/interacting Material UI components. No private theme APIs or alternate rendering implementations were substituted.

productionBuilds.result: All five builds passed, including TypeScript. TEST=TRUE selects four CMS SSG routes rather than enumerating all published routes.

unit.result: passed on the final tested candidate before reverting it

validation.checks: Standalone typecheck, scoped oxlint, formatting, and git diff --check passed.
validation.dividerCandidateSsg: All four sampled production routes had byte-identical #__next markup, Emotion CSS, and JSON-LD scripts.

productionBrowser.controls: Fixed clock, stopped carousel autoplay, disabled animations, identical YouTube iframe documents, and waited for the real Chatwoot button in both builds. No screenshot regions were masked.
productionBrowser.pixelThreshold: Zero pixels with an RGB channel difference greater than 16.
productionBrowser.existingAssetIssue: Both builds had the same two broken images on the mobile German route.

isolatedProductionFixtures.bundler: Webpack, with the actual repository sources and normal Emotion integration
isolatedProductionFixtures.builds: Both passed with the repository's ambient types included.
passed: No divider chunk requested on the plain page
Server content visible while the divider chunk download is blocked
Hydration retains the server node and input typed before hydration
Input, focus, component state, and DOM nodes survive content edits
Client navigation to a divider page
Preview markers, updates, unmount cleanup, and remount
Consumer registry overrides, including in preview

measurementMethod: Compressed bytes are sums of Node gzipSync/brotliCompressSync results for emitted files, not HTTP transfer sizes. Browser comparisons include requested chunks beyond the initial HTML; homepage samples also include a detail-page navigation and return. Analyzer per-module compressed sizes are diagnostic and are not additive substitutes for compressed chunk totals.
limitations: This is a scoped audit of the configured repository and four sampled routes, not proof that no further optimization is possible. No field LCP/INP improvement is claimed. The preview fixture did not connect to a live Storyblok Visual Editor session.
